support.note: NVIDIA or AMD GPU with 12 GB or more; the engine for the card is fetched from Strata's signed feed. No CPU-only engine.

notes: Strata (github.com/Niko1221/Strata, catalogue id strata, Terminal 0.1.59.1 from the v0.2.3.1 feed). `strata` must be on lemond's PATH (the Terminal's install folder).

{model} is a Strata run config JSON (`strata models` lists the ones setup wrote: exe, args, tokenizer, model_name). `strata serve --profile` starts the server in the foreground; `strata launch` is the interactive installer path and is not used here.

Strata's own /v1/models objects carry no owned_by, and lemond refuses an engine whose /v1/models does not report the spec's owned_by (adapter_server.cpp), so identity.unreported is set (the plane skips the check; make_adapter still reads owned_by) until Strata reports one. Measured 2026-11-10: with unreported unset the load is refused with "does not report owned_by=strata; refusing a mislabelled engine".

CPU-only check 2026-11-10: `strata serve --engine mock` (scripted engine, no model) serves /health and /v1/chat/completions, which exercises the plane's lifecycle only; a real engine needs a CUDA or ROCm card and the 84 GB model (see CONFORMANCE.md).
